key_insight: Vibe-FDTR combines an LLM agent workflow with a configuration-driven FDTR codebase to make thermal-property analysis more reliable, reproducible, and less dependent on expert manual steps.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a practical path to low-barrier, trustworthy thermal metrology for micro- and nanoscale materials characterization, with major gains in accuracy, cost, and speed.
method: Agent skills translate natural-language requests into structured FDTR analysis steps.
A configuration-driven FDTR package enforces physical and parametric consistency during execution.
An optional expert mode performs sensitivity and uncertainty checks for planning underspecified experiments.
evidence_signal: In benchmark tests, Vibe-FDTR achieved 100% success on synthetic single-step tasks and 98.9% on real-data multi-step tasks, outperforming ablated variants while cutting cost by 87.7% and runtime by more than 60%.
watch_item: Performance depends on the correctness of the domain package and agent skill design, so deployment still requires careful validation on new materials, models, and experimental conditions.
paper_title: Vibe-FDTR: An agent-oriented framework for reproducible frequency-domain thermoreflectance data analysis
